text:
Irene: Heads-up — AcmeCorp reported getting two invoices for March (INV-2026-033 and INV-2026-033-dup). One of them is missing the 'dedicated capacity' line and the other has the correct lines but the amounts are doubled. Can someone look?
Sam: Ack. Seeing the support ticket now. Do we have invoice IDs and customer internal ID?
Irene: Invoice IDs above, customer id = ACME-450. Customer attached screenshots, says they were charged twice.
Phil: @billing-bot can you pull the generation logs for those invoice ids and the billing job run at 2026-03-31T02:00Z?
billing-bot: Logs for run 2026-03-31T02:00Z: invoice_builder v2.4.1 started, 1,278 customers processed, errors: 0. Output file: invoices_20260331_0200.csv.
Zara: Hmm bot shows no errors at generation time. Could be downstream dedupe step failed or retry created new invoice. Any duplicate keys in DB?
Maya: I pulled DB rows: there are indeed two invoice rows with different PKs but same "external_ref": "INV-2026-033" for ACME-450. One row missing line items JSON (null) and amount_total = 0, the other has full line items but amount_total = 12,340.00. Support screenshot shows customer was charged twice for 12,340.00 though.
Sam: That suggests a retry inserted a second invoice with correct lines but the notification job re-sent both. Could be race between write and line-item renderer.
Phil: Can we confirm whether payment service charged twice? Payment gateway logs? @Zara can you check?
Zara: Payment logs show two capture events on 2026-03-31 03:12Z and 03:13Z for ACME-450, amount 12,340.00 each, both with different txn ids. So customer was charged twice.
Irene: Yikes. Immediate steps: 1) refund duplicate charge 2) void duplicate invoice record 3) notify customer and CC legal 4) hotfix to prevent retry-insert race.
Maya: I issued a partial refund for txn id tx_7f3a... (refund initiated). I've flagged the duplicate invoice row id 98123 with status = 'voided' to prevent re-notify.
Sam: I'll create a quick rollback/hardstop on the invoice-notify queue to prevent more emails while we investigate: pausing queue now.
Phil: For the hotfix, initial theory: invoice_builder writes invoice header first, then line items in a separate transaction. If a retry hits between those, dedupe by external_ref fails. Fix is to upsert by external_ref or atomically write header+lines. I'll open a PR to change to single transaction and add a unique constraint on external_ref.
Irene: Please also add a reconciliation script to scan for invoices with missing line_items or duplicate external_ref and auto-void them and queue refunds report.
Zara: Filed ENG-1289: "Atomic invoice write + unique external_ref constraint". Assigning to @Phil.
Maya: Adding customer comms draft: "We're sorry — duplicate charge found; refund initiated; corrected invoice attached. Expected refund arrival 3-5 business days." Irene ok to send?
Irene: Send from finance@redwood.com, CC acctmgmt. Add apology and mention refund tx id.
Sam: After we stabilize, let's run a reconcile job for last 7 days to surface any similar issues, and export to spreadsheet for ops to review.
Phil: PR ready for review, includes migration to add unique index and a backfill to merge duplicate rows into single canonical invoice (keeps earliest created and preserves payments). I'll link PR in ENG-1289.
Irene: Thanks team. Action items summary: refund complete? (Maya), queue paused (Sam), ENG ticket + PR (Phil), customer comms sent (Irene). Please update thread as you complete. :thumbsup:
